query: WITH terms AS ( INSERT INTO moods (name) SELECT DISTINCT ON (lower(name)) name FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS t(name) ORDER BY lower(name) ON CONFLICT ((lower(name))) DO UPDATE SET name = moods.name RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO manifestation_moods (manifestation_id, mood_id, source_version_id) SELECT $1, id, $3 FROM terms ON CONFLICT (manifestation_id, mood_id) DO NOTHING
